customer: Caller, a night-shift nurse from Texas leasing a full-size SUV, was frustrated that Northwind's offer came in above her lease buyout and she couldn't get a straight answer on who keeps the extra money.
agent: Customer asked who receives the difference when our offer is higher than her lease buyout. Explained per 'If our offer is more than your lease buyout' that the difference is lease equity and where it goes depends on the leasing company: Summit Auto Lease, Crescent Motor Credit and Apex Lease Co pass it to the customer, while Bluewater Leasing applies it to a car bought from Northwind. Also noted that Harbor Leasing and Ironwood Lease don't allow third-party buyouts at all, and if an offer is ever lower than the buyout, the difference is paid at the appointment, same as negative equity.
